hints.title: Citation Frequency Capping
hints.text: The maximum possible h-index for an array of length n is n. Any citation count greater than n can be capped at n.

hints.title: Bucket Counting Histogram
hints.text: Create a count array of size n plus one. Tally each paper citation into its bucket, clamping counts greater than n into bucket n.

hints.title: Suffix Accumulation Scan
hints.text: Scan the buckets from index n down to zero, maintaining a cumulative total of papers. The first index i where total papers is at least i gives the h-index.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparison-based sorting takes O(N log N) time; counting buckets avoids the logarithmic sort factor.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: An auxiliary count array of length N + 1 enables a linear time pass and suffix accumulator.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that citation values above N can be clamped into bucket N without affecting the result.
